still good pho in HCM
Nov 2023 • Solo
first visited pho 2000 in 2017, the second time was last year when i had 9 days trips to HCM, which started from late November to early Dec. i came here on 26 Nov to have dinner. i took grabbike to the place, but it was moved. luckily, a local man told me the new address,it is not far ,so i walked to the new shop.now it is located at Avanti hotel, it shares the space with the hotel. the atmosphere is a bit strange, but the food is still good. i ordered pho bo Tai and coconut drinks. the pho is soft just like what i had before, the soup is fresh, not heavy, meat is not that chewy. besides pho, they have other food too, like vermicelli, rice, spring rolls and so on.i was happy to have pho here, and found that the pic of Clinton still hanging on the wall, haha.! though the atmosphere has changed, still worth a visit. will come again for sure.
